title: Pilot on the first chg phase-2 repo

story.i_want_to: see 20 consecutive story-bound changes go through chg and loopctl end to end
story.so_that: the split is proven before any other repo depends on it

rationale: PRD §11. The pilot repo is the first repo chg phase 2 enrolls that also has a loopctl intake source.

acceptance_criteria.description: The pilot repo's intake source is switched to mode: chg in the same week chg enrolls it.
Over 20 consecutive story-bound changes, every story reaches merged from a landed event with no stage written by hand, and none records a stale-head or superseded-CI incident.
Every one of those stories has a review_records row from a child of the chg root bound to its landed sha, or escalated review_missing; no chg-rooted key verified any of them.
The result, with the 20 story ids, is recorded as a KB finding and posted on the loopctl channel.

test_cases.name: pilot audit
steps: read change_binding_get and story history for each

technical_notes: Do not pilot on loopctl itself: the loop's own deploy repo is excluded, as in Epic 45.
